description: A tool for sharing terminal over the web

option.name: --auth-header
tip: HTTP Header name for auth proxy

option.name: --base-path
tip: Expected base path for requests coming from a reverse proxy

option.name: --browser
tip: Open terminal with the default system browser

option.name: --check-origin
tip: Do not allow websocket connection from different origin

option.name: --client-option
tip: Send option to client, repeat to add more options

option.name: --credential
tip: Credential for basic authentication

option.name: --cwd
tip: Working directory to be set for the child program

option.name: --debug
tip: Set log level (default: 7)

option.name: --exit-no-conn
tip: Exit on all clients disconnection

option.name: --gid
tip: Group id to run with

option.name: --help
tip: Print this text and exit

option.name: --index
tip: Custom index.html path

option.name: --interface
tip: Network interface to bind, or UNIX domain socket path

option.name: --ipv6
tip: Enable IPv6 support

option.name: --max-clients
tip: Maximum clients to support (default: 0, no limit)

option.name: --once
tip: Accept only one client and exit on disconnection

option.name: --ping-interval
tip: Websocket ping interval (sec) (default: 5)

option.name: --port
tip: Port to listen (default: 7681, use 0 for random port)

option.name: --signal
tip: Signal to send to the command when exit it (default: 1, SIGHUP)

option.name: --socket-owner
tip: User owner of the UNIX domain socket file

option.name: --ssl
tip: Enable SSL

option.name: --ssl-ca
tip: SSL CA file path for client certificate verification

option.name: --ssl-cert
tip: SSL certificate file path

option.name: --ssl-key
tip: SSL key file path

option.name: --terminal-type
tip: Terminal type to report (default: xterm-256color)

option.name: --uid
tip: User id to run with

option.name: --url-arg
tip: Allow client to send command line arguments in URL

option.name: --version
tip: Print the version and exit

option.name: --writable
tip: Allow clients to write to the TTY (readonly by default)
